### Using the slide decks

Open a deck to present it. The arrow keys, space bar, Page Up and Page Down move between slides, Home and End jump to the first and last slide, and **F** switches to full screen. On a touch screen, swipe left or right. Each slide has its own address, so a link can point to a single slide. Printing a deck, or saving it as PDF from the print dialog, gives one slide per landscape page for handouts.
